entries.title: 2026-07-26 Morning Market Brief
entries.summary: There is no regular U.S. equity premarket on Sunday, so the setup is a weekend handoff: oil and rates remain the key macro pressure points, while the Fed, GDP/PCE/ECI and mega-cap earnings define the week ahead.

entries.title: 2026-07-24 Morning Market Brief
entries.summary: Oil's pullback is helping a short-term rebound, but elevated yields and AI capex scrutiny still limit risk appetite; Intel, Verizon, American Express and Charter drive the early single-stock signal.
